objective: Bring isolated Qwen Task4 environment quality to the level of the existing GPT appraisal / Claude Fable response environment; deployment readiness alone is insufficient.

reference_stack.caveat: This is the verified existing reference configuration, not evidence that every historical Fable-named configuration used the same routing. Its outputs are comparison evidence, not human ground truth.

conditions: action plus public background and full dialogue
same full context with previous numeric S/D removed
claim_families: inability to promise approval implies impossibility
refusal to approve implies a request to pause the conversation
format_findings: Two complete JSON objects were enclosed in Markdown fences; canonical parser already accepts these.
One output used description instead of required explanation.
entailment_task_isolation.interpretation: Qwen correctly distinguishes the tested meanings when the task explicitly asks for factual entailment, including with full private context. This does not prove correct state appraisal or general reliability.
entailment_task_isolation.comparison_limit: System task and output schema differ from full appraisal; seed and output/thinking ceilings also differ. The contrast does not isolate a unique root cause.

held_fixed: all input evidence and prior S/D

assistant_semantic_review.finding: Treats acceptance of loss risk as an unconditional choice not to pursue authorization; claims the last possible pathway has closed.
Uses an ordinary indirect judgment instead of decisive direct evidence, but still converts accepted loss risk into a closed goal pathway.
Treats an accepted risk as an actual, now-certain negative outcome.

variable_scope_ablation.decision: Do not deploy variable splitting based on this evidence. Scope reduction did not fix the recurring inference error.

conclusions: This is a failure to preserve evidence strength during state appraisal; it is not established that Qwen cannot understand the sentence.
Dialogue context or prior numeric levels alone cannot explain the failure: the simplified entailment task succeeds with them present.
Reduced output scope alone is insufficient: each of three separately judged variables still relies on a strengthened premise.
Do not characterize the original Fable-compatible prompt as simply too weak, or claim this local Qwen has reached reference quality.

quality_acceptance_target.scope: Compare corresponding scenarios under matched public task settings; report and control differences in horizon, language, modality, prompts and sampling.
required_evidence: preservation of uncertainty, actor ownership and pending/completed distinctions
grounded state judgments and reasonable deterministic transitions
coherent complete natural trajectories without unsupported facts or commitments
first-pass acceptance, actual retries, failures and per-turn latency
independent development/test separation and unchanged formal review requirements
quality_acceptance_target.note: These 13 component requests on exposed development cases do not contribute independent evaluation coverage or prove statistical equivalence.

next_method_decision.reason: Repeated isolated instruction/sampling repairs and variable-scope reduction have not fixed the same semantic error. Keep failure evidence and evaluate a materially different adaptation; do not append more scenario-specific rules or relax validators.
next_method_decision.training_status: no training started; archived teacher outputs would require quality filtering and held-out split before use
